name: AT Tool
description: Module level features to support Adpativetheme. This is a new version of AT Tools that supports Drupal 10 and Drupal 11.
project_description:
Drupal 8/9/10/11 
 The original AT Tools project, developed by Jeff Burnz, was seemingly abandoned. I didn't have security coverage permission to become a maintainer on that project, but I've created a new module based on it here. If this allows me to get the permission, I may merge the two projects, but this will do for a D9/10/11-compatible version as of now.

 AT Tool provides theme and admin features that may be required by your theme. This is now a required module for  AT Theme  in Drupal 8/9.

 Includes:  AT Tools  and the  AT Theme Generator  module  (required to generate new sub-themes) .
